basis: spec/layers/03-product.layer.json description: the product layer's modelling rules (maintainer decisions 2026-11-05), with Context Studio's 8 product proposals judged against them

actions.note: realization runs upward through product: other layers realize product elements, and product reaches the business layer through software capabilities (realize business functions) and user workflows (realize business processes); a workflow is the user's way of carrying out the business process, not a whole containing it (Context Studio proposal op 1)
a persona describes a kind of person, so it references the stakeholder and business role it stands for rather than realizing or serving them (Context Studio proposal op 2)

a user workflow reaches features and software capabilities only through its steps: the workflow composes steps, steps use features, features realize software capabilities (Context Studio proposal op 3)

realization runs upward through product: other layers realize product elements, and product reaches the business layer through software capabilities (realize business functions) and user workflows (realize business processes); a feature reaches the business through the software capability it realizes (application service realizes business service covers the implementation side) (Context Studio proposal op 4)

a user workflow reaches features and software capabilities only through its steps: the workflow composes steps, steps use features, features realize software capabilities (Context Studio proposed feature uses software capability, which feature realizes software capability already says) (Context Studio proposal op 5)
the user workflow serves the persona; its steps do not serve separately (Context Studio proposal op 6)

a persona describes a kind of person, so it references the stakeholder and business role it stands for rather than realizing or serving them (Context Studio proposed business function references business role, a different element, which would drop these links) (Context Studio proposal op 7)

a user workflow reaches features and software capabilities only through its steps: the workflow composes steps, steps use features, features realize software capabilities; features exist independently of any workflow, so composes was wrong too (Context Studio proposal op 8)
one meaning, one predicate: fulfills and satisfies mean the same; satisfies is the spec's usual predicate (69 uses against 9)
